subject: Q1 retroactive usage & settlement - StratoHealth
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@stratohealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tom Greene <tgreene@stratohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 retroactive usage & settlement - StratoHealth

Hi Rishi —

Our ops team flagged an unexpected spike in API traffic tied to a batch job that re-ran index generation between Feb 10–14. That window generated ~1.2M additional tokens beyond our committed run-rate. We attached our exported usage report (strato_q1_usage_export.csv) for your review.

Can Redwood confirm whether this qualifies as billable overage under our current Dedicated plan and, if so, provide an itemized true-up invoice and timeline for payment? Procurement is standing by to process a one-time charge — PO process usually takes 7–10 business days once we have a final invoice.

Also looping in Tom (engineering) in case you need raw logs.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Platform Ops
StratoHealth

Attachments: strato_q1_usage_export.csv (CSV, 184KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@stratohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 retroactive usage & settlement - StratoHealth

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the heads up and for the export — I pulled the CSV and we can walk through this. At a high level: additional tokens from batch jobs are typically billable unless covered by a negotiated true-up clause; we need to reconcile the timestamps and model variants used during the spike.

Next steps from our side:
- Laura (finance) will run a reconciliation against our ingestion logs to map token usage to billed units.
- I’ll ask engineering to validate the model/endpoint IDs in the CSV (Tom is on copy if you can confirm the environment).
- We’ll propose a single true-up invoice for the incremental tokens plus a short breakdown (tokens x rate).

Can you confirm whether StratoHealth would prefer a single invoice or a split invoice (one technical line item + one service line item)? Also please share PO lead/contact if you have them.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 retroactive usage & settlement - StratoHealth

Hi Alyssa —

I ran an initial reconciliation against the ingestion logs. Short summary: we can attribute ~1,185,420 tokens of the spike directly to your tenant between 2026-02-10T00:00Z and 2026-02-14T23:59Z. At your current effective rate (your Dedicated rate + reserved capacity uplift), that maps to a gross charge of $1,780.53.

I've attached a draft "proposed_trueup_invoice.pdf" with the line items (token delta, unit price, subtotal, taxes). Two practical notes:
1) Per your contract, retroactive usage is billable.
2) We can apply a one-time courtesy credit if there's a documented operational cause and you request it within 30 days of the spike.

If you can confirm PO number and whether you want a single invoice, we’ll finalize and route to finance. Typical turnaround: final invoice issued within 48 business hours after confirmation, payment terms Net 30.

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_trueup_invoice.pdf (PDF, 32KB)

Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 retroactive usage & settlement - StratoHealth

Hi Laura / Rishi —

Thanks for the quick reconciliation. Procurement provided PO #45321 and attached our internal PO (strato_po_45321.pdf). We prefer a single invoice that references the PO.

A quick ask on the courtesy credit: StratoHealth experienced an internal pipeline misconfiguration that caused the re-run; we’d like to request the one-time courtesy credit you mentioned, if eligible. If possible, could Redwood apply a 10% credit to the true-up subtotal? That would help close this quickly and keep our staff focused on remediation.

If you can issue the final invoice with the PO number and the adjusted credit applied, I’ll route for expedited sign-off.

Best,
Alyssa

Attachments: strato_po_45321.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
